label: Électro sombre / cinématique
blurb: Pulsation lente, séquenceurs, synthés analogiques, monde.
core: brooding analog electronic music, widescreen and physical

grafts.label: Quatuor à cordes
grafts.phrase: a close-miked string quartet with rosin and bow noise

grafts.label: Field recording urbain
grafts.phrase: faint field recordings, rain and distant city, as a bed

grafts.label: Groupe live en relais
grafts.phrase: a live drummer and bassist gradually taking over from the machine

grafts.label: Textures tracker Amiga
grafts.phrase: low-bit tracker-style arpeggios and crunchy 8-bit sample hits

far.label: Guitare saturée
far.phrase: an overdriven valve-amp guitar riff cutting through the synths

far.label: Cuivres de film noir
far.phrase: muted film-noir brass, smoky and low

far.label: Métallophones gamelan
far.phrase: interlocking gamelan metallophones shimmering in the pulse

presets.label: Adieu cinématique
presets.note: Nappes graves, pulsation lente, cordes, gravité.
detail: deep slow-motion pads, a muffled heartbeat kick, strings rising in grave silence

presets.label: Arpège moteur
presets.note: Séquence analogique infinie, motorik, bascule live.

presets.label: Berlin × Amiga

presets.label: Industriel organique
presets.note: Percussions métalliques trouvées, synthés qui sifflent, cœur mécanique lent.
